description: Set or remove environment variables of an app (null removes one); the app restarts with them. For secrets such as a Discord bot token or API keys, do NOT ask the person to paste them into the chat: give them set_url from list_env so they enter it on the press5 page themselves. Use this tool for settings that are not secret.

token.description: A press5 token (p5_...). Only needed when the MCP connection has no Authorization header, e.g. right after login_check.

name: set_env
title: Set app environment variables
